title: Measure publish_delta_outgoing on Windows and set its default deadline from that measurement or make it scale with the work
outcome: Windows publication deadlines are justified by measured required work, with bounded uncertainty-preserving behavior.
acceptance: Measure the real publish_delta_outgoing workflow on representative Windows inputs and record exact producer, clean input identity, environment and per-phase timings, distinguishing validation, push, fetch and ancestry work.

Use the measurements to decide whether to retain or change the default deadline or reduce/scale required work; any implementation preserves bounded operation deadlines, uncertainty, selected-input revalidation and single-dispatch guarantees.
Record the measured decision and focused validation for any resulting behavior change; a fixture-specific budget change alone is not evidence that the ordinary default serves real Windows use.
